title: Luke's Death Chest
description: A minecraft plugin to send items and experience to a chest upon death
body:
Sends items and experience to a chest when a player dies. Place a sign on a chest and type [deathchest] to register your death chest. Break sign to remove

Respects the keepInventory gamerule - Set keepInventory to false for the plugin to function.

![Double chest with Death Chest sign placed on it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1354b01e7e6adf191801e4c34aa0132a3df8cb4d.png)

Commands: 
/ldc remove - Remove your death chest with a command 
/ldc admin list - List all registered death chests. 
/ldc admin - List location of and the last time a players chest was used. 
/ldc admin remove - Remove a player's death chest.

Permissions: 
lukesdeathchest.use - Ability to create and use a death chest. 
lukesdeathchest.admin - Ability to use admin commands.

Idea from ResurrectionChest by MagmaGuy which has not been updated to 1.21.11 yet. ResurrectionChest source code was not used as a reference or inspiration for this plugin's code. https://modrinth.com/plugin/resurrectionchest

I cannot guarantee this plugin is perfectly made as there are most certainly ways I could've done it better. DM me on discord (akaLuke) or make a github issue if you find problems.

I will only consider updating this plugin if ResurrectionChest is not updated for newer versions, this plugin stops functioning in newer versions, and there is a demand for an update.
